messages:
Alex C: quick handoff — noticed a regional routing spike in eu-west around 18:20 UTC, started seeing ~5-10% 429s on /v1/chat and a few 503s correlating with model fallback. alert: incident-bot posted pager.
incident-bot: ALERT: 429 spike (eu-west) — 18:20 UTC — severity: high — affected: hosted-api, fallback to dedicated noticed. See summary below.
Alex C: What I did so far:
- validated dashboards: p95 latency up from 80ms -> 420ms for eu-west
- traced to routing path A->B where weight build-up caused queueing; autoscaler healthy
- triggered a canary rollback on the most recent routing/weight change (deployed ~18:12)
- toggled temporary circuit-breaker to reduce prefix batching on that path
- opened runbook and left notes: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regional-routing

Priya N: current customer impact?
Alex C: Observed intermittent errors for a small subset of enterprise customers (eu-west). Most traffic fell back to nearby region but some requests timed out before fallback kick-in. No data leak, just request failures and latencies.
Priya N: any ongoing mitigation we need to hand to next shift?
Alex C: Yes — things are mostly stable but not fully recovered. Canary rollback reduced error rate to ~1-2% from peak ~8%. Still watching for re-introduced weight changes. Key items for next shift:
- Watch eu-west p95 and 429 rate closely for next 2 hours
- Keep the canary rollback in place until routing weights validated by TrafficEng (Priya to follow up)
- If errors creep back above 3% for 5m, escalate to SRE paging and re-run full rollback to previous commit

Jonah R: I'm primary starting 19:00 UTC; I can take ownership of the next hour. Note: I'm on a call 19:30-20:15 so Mei will be backup during that window.
Mei L: ack, I'll be secondary 19:30-20:30. If anything spikes while Jonah is on call, ping me and I'll trigger the full rollback if requested.
Alex C: additional context / commands used:
```
# check routing weights
curl -sS https://internal-api/routing/weights?region=eu-west | jq .
# rollback canary
deploy-bot: /rollback route-config canary-2026-03-15-1812
```
deploy-bot: Rollback started: canary-2026-03-15-1812 -> stable at 18:27 UTC (initiated by Alex C).
Priya N: I've flagged TrafficEng to audit the weight-change PR. ETA 1h. I'll post their findings in this thread.
Alex C: runbook pointers:
- regional routing play: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/regional-routing (steps 1-7)
- fallback/circuit breaker guide: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/circuit-breaker
- escalation matrix: https://redwood.internal/ops/escalation

Open action items for next shift:
- Priya: confirm PR audit results + decide whether to revert the weight-change permanently or patch the balancer logic
- Jonah: keep watch on eu-west 429 rate and p95; if >3% sustained for 5m, run `deploy-bot /rollback route-config stable-previous`
- Mei: be ready to toggle circuit-breaker setting back to aggressive if latency climbs
- Alex: I'll follow up with logs and a short post-incident note tomorrow AM

Jonah R: noted, will take primary and runbook steps. +1 on escalation thresholds.
Mei L: +thumbsup: I'll monitor and can take immediate action.
Priya N: thanks all. I'm leaving a TODO in traffic PR and will update here. If anything urgent happens ping @Priya directly.
Alex C: handoff complete — primary: Jonah R (19:00-23:00), secondary: Mei L (covers 19:30-20:30), coverage gap: none immediate but Jonah's short call covered. If you need the on-call rotation list: /who-oncall
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigating -> watch(eyes) — next check in 30m.
